limits: Uses fund.py's exact rules and the same daily prices. Prices are dividend-adjusted, so share counts and rupee amounts are close to, not exactly, what a broker would have shown on each date.
Uses today's Nifty 100 members back in time (survivorship bias): stocks that dropped out of the index are missing.
Trades at the closing price of the execution day; real fills slip. 0.2% is charged on every rupee bought or sold.
Tax estimate: 20% on gains from shares held under a year, 12.5% above ₹1.25 lakh on shares held longer; losses are not carried forward. Not tax advice.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
